NEWS: Australia's fertility rate has fallen to a record low of 1.48 births per woman.

The rate is now well below the replacement level of around 2.1, marking the lowest level ever recorded in the country's history.

Australians are also waiting longer to start families. The average age of mothers has risen from 25 in 1971 to 32 in 2024.

Experts point to rising living costs, delayed parenthood and changing lifestyle choices as key factors behind the decline.

Grok Imagine Video 1.5 is now ranked #1 in the Image-to-Video Arena.

The model sits at the top of the leaderboard ahead of offerings from ByteDance and Alibaba.

What's especially notable is that Grok reached the #1 spot while still labeled as a preliminary release.

xAI entered the image and video generation race much later than many competitors.

Now it's leading the rankings.

The pace of improvement has been remarkable.
Elon Musk - “AI will be the best or worst thing ever for humanity.”
